title: Lookup Table-based Multiplication-free All-digital DNN Accelerator Featuring Self-Synchronous Pipeline Accumulation
problem: DNN inference requires massive matrix multiplications consuming significant power; MADDNESS approach substitutes multiplications with LUT lookups, but prior analog conversion circuits are area-inefficient and accuracy-sensitive.
motivation: Power consumption in DNNs is dominated by arithmetic operations; replacing multiplications with table lookups can reduce power, but requires efficient, robust digital implementation.
method: Proposes all-digital MADDNESS-based accelerator with self-synchronous pipeline accumulator. Uses LUT-based computation instead of multipliers; self-synchronous design eliminates clock distribution complexity, improving area efficiency and PVT robustness. Post-layout simulation in 22nm CMOS demonstrates 2.5x energy efficiency and 5x area efficiency improvements.
key_novelty: First all-digital MADDNESS accelerator with self-synchronous pipeline accumulator, achieving PVT-invariant high-efficiency DNN inference.
contributions: All-digital MADDNESS implementation replacing multiplications with LUT operations
Self-synchronous pipeline accumulator eliminating clock distribution
Compact, area-efficient design with PVT-invariant operation
2.5x higher energy efficiency (174 TOPS/W) vs. conventional accelerator
5x higher area efficiency (2.01 TOPS/mm²) vs. conventional accelerator
primary_theme: Multiplication-free DNN accelerator using self-synchronous LUT pipeline
